name: Songbook and practice
description: Practice logs, set lists, chord charts and songbooks, from plain files. Practice reads a log CSV (date, piece, minutes): minutes per week and per piece, streaks and progress against a weekly goal. Set list adds up the song lengths against a slot and warns about big key jumps and the same tempo three songs in a row. Transpose moves a plain-text chord chart or ChordPro file by semitones or to a key, with sharps or flats to suit, and suggests a capo. Lyrics checks lyric sheets for unlabelled sections and missing verses, and against a set list. Index builds a contents page, an alphabetical index and an index by key in Markdown for Pandoc. Counting and text work; it does not hear music. For notation use the Music scores tool. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Practice log summary (CSV)
presets.description: Columns date, piece, minutes. Minutes per week (Monday to Sunday) and per piece, longest and current streak, and progress against a weekly goal (goal=150 in the extra arguments; today=YYYY-MM-DD to check as of another day).

presets.label: Set list builder check (CSV)
presets.description: Columns title, minutes (m:ss or minutes), key, tempo. Running time and total against the slot (slot=60, gap=30 seconds between songs in the extra arguments), key jumps of 3 or more steps round the circle of fifths, the same tempo three in a row.

presets.label: Transpose a chord chart
presets.description: Plain-text chords above lyrics ("C G Am F") or ChordPro [C] markers. Type +2, -3 or to=G (with from=C if the first chord is not the key); add flats or sharps to choose the spelling. Slash chords and suffixes are kept; a capo suggestion follows the chart.

presets.label: Lyric sheet check
presets.description: Songs start with "# Title"; sections are labelled [Verse 1], Chorus:, ## Bridge or ChordPro. Unlabelled blocks, missing verse numbers, and, with the path of a set list CSV in the extra arguments, songs missing from either side.

presets.label: Songbook contents and index (Markdown)
presets.description: Songs start with "# Title" and an optional "Key: G" line. Writes the contents, an alphabetical index (leading articles ignored) and an index by key, ready for Pandoc (pandoc FILE.md --toc). Type title="My songbook" for the title.
